description: This file implements a launcher class for the Evergreen platform, managing target launching, staging, and platform-specific content setup for different embedded platforms like Linux, Raspi, and RDK within the Starboard abstraction layer.

classes.name: Launcher
classes.description: A class that manages launching and staging of Evergreen targets across different platforms, handling content setup, command-line parameter construction, and platform-specific content staging.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Launcher, sets up environment variables, determines platform-specific configurations, and prepares the staging directory.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the target by delegating to the platform-specific launcher and handles logging.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Terminates the running target via the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: _StageTargetsAndContents
methods.description: Prepares the staging directory with platform-specific content and binaries.

methods.name: _StageTargetsAndContentsLinux
methods.description: Stages content for Linux platforms, copying necessary binaries and content into the staging directory.

methods.name: _StageTargetsAndContentsRaspi
methods.description: Stages content for Raspi platforms, copying binaries and content accordingly.

methods.name: _StageTargetsAndContentsRdk
methods.description: Stages content for RDK platforms, copying binaries and content accordingly.

methods.name: SupportsSuspendResume
methods.description: Delegates suspend/resume support query to the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: SendResume
methods.description: Delegates resume command to the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: SendSuspend
methods.description: Delegates suspend command to the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: SendConceal
methods.description: Delegates conceal command to the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: SendFocus
methods.description: Delegates focus command to the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: SendFreeze
methods.description: Delegates freeze command to the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: SendStop
methods.description: Delegates stop command to the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: SupportsDeepLink
methods.description: Checks if deep linking is supported via the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: SendDeepLink
methods.description: Sends a deep link command via the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: GetStartupTimeout
methods.description: Retrieves startup timeout from the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: GetHostAndPortGivenPort
methods.description: Gets host and port info from the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: GetTargetPath
methods.description: Retrieves the target path from the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: GetDeviceIp
methods.description: Retrieves device IP from the platform-specific launcher.

methods.name: GetDeviceOutputPath
methods.description: Retrieves device output path from the platform-specific launcher.
